what_happened: context/project/lean4/patterns/dependency-tracing.md Shape 1 (forward transitive closure) uses bare ci.value?, which on Lean v4.33 returns none for every thmInfo unless allowOpaque := true is passed. The probe therefore walks TYPES ONLY for theorems and silently reports a clean closure. First run over all 68 marker sites returned zero field-access hits with plausible-looking closure sizes (12-974 constants), which the doc's own anti-silence heuristic ('a non-trivial closure size is evidence the traversal is doing real work') does NOT catch. Fix: ci.value? (allowOpaque := true).

A single compiled metaprogram (transitive constant-closure over the elaborated proof term, matched against the 8 constants through which FrameOver.IsRegular's four fields can be read) classified all 68 marker sites in one run, replacing the planned per-site transplant-probe sweep (68 scratch copies + 68 compiles). Validated against 6 hand-corrected control markers in UniversalCover.lean/HistoryMorphism.lean/TaskFrame.lean, all reproduced exactly; value-only and type+value variants agree on all 68 rows; 0 of 68 module-provenance mismatches. Probe retained at specs/evidence/constraints-consumed-marker-audit/marker-consumption-probe.lean.

Correcting an over-reporting marker on a binder-carrying declaration FAILS check-module-invariants.sh C34a (enforced, exit-code-affecting), because C34a refuses any marker omitting a constraint its own binder supplies unless discharged by delegation to a binder-free twin or by field re-export. Simulated against the live census for 4 representative sites (PathHom.toPath_comp, PathHom.id, mem_lawHist_iff_isStepPath, base_taskRel_eq_ofStepRel): all 4 FAIL. 22 of the 28 over-reporters carry the binder, so a docstring-only edit is not available for them; each needs a binder-free twin (or binder removal) landed in the same phase as the marker edit.

docs/development/MODULE_INVARIANTS.md (C34 row) and docs/development/REFERENCE_NORMAL_FORM.md both state the live C34a discharge-group counts as 7 omit-nothing / 18 delegation / 2 re-export. A live run of the C34 block reports 62 omit-nothing / 22 delegation / 2 re-export over 163 markers and 341 binder-carrying declarations. The two prose counts are stale by a wide margin.
Research report's compiled closure probe classified all 68 marker sites in one run, so plan authoring needed no per-site transplant probes; only the 3 binder-removal candidates retain a probe step.

Research report's enabler table lists 'no' for a binder-free twin of FrameOver.taskRel_eq_iter, but taskRel_eq_iter_of_constraints already exists at FormalSystem/Semantics/IntNormalForm.lean:259 with marker 'Compositionality, Seriality, Limit'. Re-derived at plan time; the ConeUnravelling phase therefore needs no new enabler twin.

Research report's 'the 22 do not need 22 twins' understates C34a: delegates() requires the delegate to be named in the ROW'S OWN body with an identical marker and no bundling-class mention anywhere in its span, so each binder-carrying corrected site needs its own binder-free twin (or binder deletion). Enabler leverage reduces proof COST per twin, not the twin COUNT. Plan sized at ~19 per-site twins plus 3 enabler twins across 7 correction phases rather than 4 phases with 3 twins.

Phase 1's stated criterion 'check-module-invariants.sh exits 0' cannot hold: the gate carries a PRE-EXISTING FAIL C16 (env_linter unusedArguments on FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/LadderPump.lean:1825 and :1868), identical in a 06:39 pre-dispatch run of the same gate and in this phase's run, and outside this phase's file territory. Phase 4 scoped build (FormalSystem.Semantics.Presheaf, 1211 jobs) passed on the first attempt: Beh.ofGerm's reduction to a delegating definition did not break germ_ofGerm (rfl) or ofGerm_germ, so the plan's prepared inversion fallback (keep ofGerm's body as the real definition) was not needed.

Plan phase 4 names the binder-free twin 'Beh.ofGerm_of_serial_limit', but it is a 'def' and check-module-invariants.sh C26 enforces lowerCamelCase for def/abbrev names (theorem is exempt, which is why phase 3's two 'theorem' twins named '_of_constraints' passed). The gate reported 'FAIL C26 ... Behavior.lean:254: ofGerm_of_serial_limit -- rename to lowerCamelCase'. Renamed to 'Beh.ofGermOfSerialLimit'; signature, marker and delegation unchanged. The same collision will hit every def-valued twin the plan names with a snake_case suffix in phases 5-7 (PathHom.id_of_serial_limit at plan line 326, and the toPath/ofStep/ofPath twins), so those phases must use lowerCamelCase names for def twins.

PathHom.id_comp's twin could not reuse Beh.ofGerm_germ: the only germ-inverse form in Behavior.lean carries [F.IsRegular], and a C34a delegate's span may name no bundling class. The germ-inverse step was proved inline as a local 'have hgerm' inside the twin, translating Behavior.lean's ofGerm_germ proof verbatim. No new top-level declaration and no edit outside this phase's file territory.

scripts/typst-sync-check.sh rejects '--counts-only --fix' with 'unexpected extra argument(s): --fix' (exit 2); --fix is a standalone, build-requiring mode. The plan task text reads as if --fix composes with --counts-only. Correct sequence: --counts-only to detect drift, then a green full build, then a bare --fix.

The PathCat half needed explicit instance plumbing the plan did not anticipate: a binder-free twin of a Category-indexed declaration supplies no Category (PathCat F) instance, so PathCat.lenOfConstraints' type had to be written as @CategoryTheory.Functor with both instances explicit, its body needed a letI to elaborate the structure instance, len_map_of_constraints had to use @CategoryTheory.Functor.map in full, and both PathCat.categoryOfConstraints and PathCat.lenOfConstraints had to be marked @[reducible] so that Factorization ((len).map e) still unifies with Factorization e.len at reducible transparency in len_isDiscreteConduche. Phases 6 and 7 touch toPath/ofStep/ofPath, which are also stated over the category, and will hit the same wall.

Phase 4's handoff warned that C26 would reject the plan's snake_case names for def-valued twins. Applying lowerCamelCase pre-emptively (idOfSerialLimit, categoryOfConstraints, lenOfConstraints) made C26 pass on the first gate run with no rename cycle.

The plan's Scope Hypothesis for phase 5 was exact: re-grepping Path.lean for the full-four marker string returned marker lines 421, 449, 458, 490, 705, 719, 728, 907, matching the predicted ~422/~450/~459/~491/~706/~720/~729/~908 one-for-one.
